what: How long the scripts/check.py step of the ci workflow took on the GitHub-hosted runner in the three most recent push runs that succeeded (read on 2026-10-18, before the run of the next push). README.md says how long the check takes on a CI runner; tests/test_readme_numbers.py rounds the shortest and the longest of these steps to the nearest half hour and compares them with the words the README types. This file is a record of what was read, not a proof; the runs are on the public repository's Actions page.
source: GitHub API, repos/JacoboPacheco/third-of-a-percent/actions/runs/<id>/jobs, the step named 'scripts/check.py' of the job 'check'; runs listed by gh run list --workflow ci.yml, event push, conclusion success
